At Gold Star, we’ve been serving our guests delicious Cincinnati-style Chili since 1965 when the Daoud brothers bought a restaurant in the Cincinnati neighborhood of Mt. Washington. They wanted to make chili the right way: always fresh, never frozen and made in small batches to ensure quality. Crafted from our founders’ secret family recipe of 13 perfectly blended spices to make Cincinnati’s classic chili favorites the Cheese Coney, and 3-, 4- and 5-Way Chili Spaghetti. Our menu offers something to make everyone happy from fresh grilled-to-order burgers, southern-style chicken sandwiches, vegetarian chili, double-decker deli sandwiches to loaded French fries, hand-tossed salads and 100% real ice cream shakes. It may not be what you would expect from a neighborhood chili parlor, but we’re not big on labels anyway. We invite all of our guests to come as you are, like what you like, and follow your own recipe.Today, Gold Star has 70 corporate- and franchise-owned locations throughout Ohio, Kentucky and Indiana and is actively developing new franchise opportunities in the region. For more information, visit www.goldstarchili.com. Gold Star is hiring for all positions with competitive pay and benefits; apply to join our team at: https://www.goldstarchili.com/careers.

Tom & Chee serves much more than simple grilled cheese – it’s a sensory experience that starts with great service and ends with satisfaction. From adventurous, handcrafted melts to savory soups and fresh salads, the menu offers elevated comfort food, with options like gluten-free bread, vegan cheese and vegan/vegetarian menu items to satisfy every guest.What began in a small tent next to an ice-skating rink in Cincinnati’s Fountain Square quickly but quietly grew to multiple stores in the Cincinnati market and then began franchising. Tom & Chee has been featured on ABC's Shark Tank, The Chew, and The Travel Channel's Man vs. Food Nation and Amazing Eats. The Today Show named their Grilled Cheese Donut one of the “Best Sandwiches in America.” Tom & Chee is hiring for all positions with competitive pay and benefits; apply to join our team at www.tomandchee.com/join-the-team. For more information, visit www.tomandchee.com.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Established in 1984 in Cincinnati, Ohio, the sports-themed restaurant franchise has always been committed to giving customers the finest quality wings.  Over the years, the brand has pioneered and perfected the art of homemade sauces, customizable heat profiles and fresh wings, and has expanded its elevated menu to offer specialty burgers, salads and many other items for our guests and their families.  With more than 80 units across the globe,  Wings & Rings is excited to continue to expand and further evolve to meet the needs of families and wing connoisseurs everywhere.  For more information, please visit www.ownwingsandrings.com.
past.employee_description: Established in 1984, Buffalo Wings & Rings (BW&R) is a franchisor of sports restaurants.  Currently President and CEO of the restaurant franchise based in Cincinnati, Ohio with over 50 locations in 16 states. Leading the process of evolving the brand to reflect the needs of today's discerning guests. Oversaw research leading to a new restaurant design, developed a new menu with culinary partners and restored the in-restaurant experience to bring people and good food together while watching their favorite teams.

Gold Star Chili Inc. is a $70 million regional quick service restaurant chain and manufacturer with over 120 locations in three states.

Established new packaged-goods business unit responsible for marketing, sales, financial and promotional analysis and operations that contributed over 20% to consolidated net income. 

Formed a cross-functional team that captured 30% market share in five years by developing and marketing seven packaged-good products. 

Leader of a cross-functional quality team that developed a Customer Relationship Management process for managing consumer feedback.

Developed design/brand strategy for all package design and point of sale materials.

Developed a multi-disciplinary plan to reposition the Gold Star Chili brand which increased brand awareness by 30% and brand preference by 25%.

Worked closely with franchisees to develop and implement our strategic marketing vision which resulted in a 300% increase in the marketing budget and exceeding industry sales growth eight out of ten years.

Identified the opportunity and led the implementation and marketing efforts of a customer loyalty program that increased average check size by 45%.

Led a cross-functional team that researched, developed, tested and launched five new products/line extensions accounting for 13% of sales.

Negotiated media, agency and sponsorship agreements with organizations such as the Cincinnati Reds and Bengals, Pepsico, and Greater Cincinnati Chamber of Commerce.

marchFIRST was a $1 billion professional services firm focusing on business strategy, technology integration, and brand development.

Managed business and brand strategy initiatives for Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), Medical and Retail industries. Projects include an array of management responsibilities from product repositioning efforts to complete brand identity development and implementation programs.

Responsibilities included budgeting, scope management and human resource allocation. Individual project responsibilities included oversight of and interaction with creative services, audience development, content, Web usability, and technology teams to ensure high quality deliverables built on business strategies objectives and goals. 

Coordinated and analyzed qualitative and quantitative research initiatives to support development, repositioning and maintenance of brand strategies including specific brand identity, offline to online commerce development and new product communications components.

past.employer_linkedin_description: The Music Resource Center—Cincinnati is a multifaceted teen program that uses recording and performing arts, as well as life skills mentoring to create a sense of empowerment & accomplishment in the urban community.

Our 3700+ square-foot East Walnut Hills facility offers our members access to Digital Recording Studios, Practice Rooms, performance opportunities, & more! www.mrccinci.org

past.employer_linkedin_description: We are proud to be the official philanthropic partner of Cincinnati Parks. Our work has been mission-driven since 1995 with a commitment to supporting the conservation and enhancement of Cincinnati’s parks and greenspaces. When you invest in our most treasured public asset—our parks—you are making an impact for generations to come.Focusing on conservation, activation, and advocacy, our mission is to improve and enhance YOUR neighborhood Cincinnati Parks.

SGK, part of the Propelis Group, is a global brand and content production agency. From idea to implementation, we give brands the freedom to speak louder, scale faster and grow stronger. We simplify marketing and amplify brands to deliver value. We have more than 6,500 employees and 1,500 clients worldwide, sales of $548 million in 2023 and have been advising many of the world’s greatest brands for 75+ years.
past.employee_description:
Brandimage, formerly Lipson Alport Glass & Associates (laga), is a professional services firm specializing in brand strategy, product innovation and package/structural design since 1952. 

Overall responsibilities include strategic planning, P&L management, budgeting, proposal development, new business development, scope management and human resource allocation. 

Established the Cincinnati consulting business unit accounting for 18% of gross revenue and enhanced gross profit by educating the account service team on consulting methodologies and developing a standardized estimating process.  

Successfully broke down barriers and eliminated silos across different disciplines by developing strategic departmental goals and collaborative workflow processes.

Supervised a team of seven to execute strategic consulting services, refine methodologies, manage key accounts and provide internal training of consulting services. 

Continued to develop and evolve strategic offerings in the areas of consumer research, brand equity analysis, positioning strategy, nomenclature development and product innovation for B2B and B2C clients such as P&G, The Kroger Company, Bayer, Tyson Foods, Alcoa Building Products, Lowe’s Home Improvement, Cadbury Schweppes, Supervalu and Pennington Seed.

Evaluated brand development, repositioning and line extension opportunities for retail and manufacturing clients across different industries and various distribution channels.

past.employer_linkedin_description: AVI Foodsystems, Inc.Founded in 1960, AVI Foodsystems has evolved into one of the most respected and trusted food service companies in the nation. Providing comprehensive food services with a focus on the highest quality and freshest ingredients, impeccable service and total value is the reputation we have earned and live up to everyday. We serve thousands of clients and millions of customers daily through our contemporary cafés, state-of-the-art vending programs, premier catering services, superior concession venues and exclusive beverage and coffee systems. However, our commitment extends far beyond food... AVI believes in family values, developing our team members, encouraging healthy lifestyles, giving back to our communities and supporting diversity in any way possible. The success of AVI is built upon family values and tradition. From modest means, AVI has grown into the largest independently owned food service company in the United States by exceeding the expectations of our customers. Today, AVI is still a family company dedicated to serving our customers with the same personal relationships and integrity as we did nearly 60 years ago. Our unprecedented growth and account retention reflects the devotion to our core values; excellence and relationships. Our team members are at the forefront of the commitment we make to each customer. They are empowered to serve our customers and guests with the most innovative and creative food services possible.

From adventurous, handcrafted melts to savory soups and fresh salads, the menu offers elevated comfort food, with options like gluten-free bread, vegan cheese and vegan/vegetarian menu items to satisfy every guest.What began in a small tent next to an ice-skating rink in Cincinnati’s Fountain Square quickly but quietly grew to multiple stores in the Cincinnati market and then began franchising. Tom & Chee has been featured on ABC's Shark Tank, The Chew, and The Travel Channel's Man vs. Food Nation and Amazing Eats. The Today Show named their Grilled Cheese Donut one of the “Best Sandwiches in America.” Tom & Chee is hiring for all positions with competitive pay and benefits; apply to join our team at www.tomandchee.com/join-the-team. For more information, visit www.tomandchee.com.

past.employer_name: Cincinnati and Hamilton County Public Library
past.employer_linkedin_description: Cincinnati & Hamilton County Public Library has been cultivating curiosity from the moment we first opened our doors in 1853. Since then, we have evolved into one of the biggest and busiest libraries in the country: supporting minds of all kinds who seek to unlock their full potential. With 41 neighborhood branches, a vast range of programming and ever-growing collection of virtual resources, we're proud to be a place where everyone can learn without limits. To learn more, visit cincinnatilibrary.org or call 513-369-6900.

past.employer_linkedin_description: Since 1969, we’ve believed that experience is everything—from greeting to ambiance to flavors. We opened our first restaurant that year, and in the decades since, we’ve continuously refined our culinary and hospitality talents, creating countless unforgettable dining experiences.The Restaurants Unlimited portfolio includes 19 unique upscale-casual and fine-dining brands spanning over 40 locations, including Henry’s Tavern, Palomino, Portland City Grill, Palisade and Cutters Crabhouse. Our time-honored restaurants serve guests in nine states in the West, Southwest and Midwest.Our business continues to thrive thanks to the exceptional people whose passion is to create experiences that matter—at every one of our tables. We proudly offer employees competitive compensation, excellent benefits and encouragement to grow their careers in our family of restaurants.
